mapper.select: SELECT * FROM model_prices WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM model_prices WHERE model = #{model} AND (group_id = #{groupId} OR group_id IS NULL) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY group_id IS NULL ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM model_prices WHERE platform = #{platform} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY model ASC
SELECT * FROM model_prices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY platform, model LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_prices WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_prices ( model, platform, input_price, output_price, cache_write_price, cache_read_price, group_id, enabled, notes, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{model}, #{platform}, #{inputPrice}, #{outputPrice}, #{cacheWritePrice}, #{cacheReadPrice}, #{groupId}, #{enabled}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW(), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE model_prices SET model = #{model}, platform = #{platform}, input_price = #{inputPrice}, output_price = #{outputPrice}, cache_write_price = #{cacheWritePrice}, cache_read_price = #{cacheReadPrice}, group_id = #{groupId}, enabled = #{enabled}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE model_prices SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
